caveat: isRelevant below started as a PLACEHOLDER auto-seeded from category membership (Software / QA / Machine Learning-AI = true, everything else = false, copying JobLens:TargetCategories as it stood at the time) and has since been hand-corrected: each posting was read against the profile in appsettings.json and re-labeled where category membership alone was wrong (e.g. an Aeronautics/EE navigation-algorithms posting under Software, or biomedical/mechanical-engineering roles under QA/ML). TargetCategories has since gained a fourth category, Automation, but none of the postings below fall in it, so it didn't affect these labels. Precision/recall/F1 computed from these labels reflect real human judgment, not just the category filter.
